name: Denver Visible Human Female 2022
access_restrictions: public; Cloudflare JS challenge blocks plain HTTP clients (HTTP 403); fetched through a local Chrome session
notes: Imported: 128 final STL meshes (bones, muscles, cartilage, ligaments; sacrum and coccyx stored in the Left folder); final geometry is smoothed and overclosure-corrected; frame verified empirically as x right, y anterior, z superior in mm; source DOI 10.56902/COB.vh.2022.1; no fat geometry in the female final STL archive

name: NLM Visible Human Female fresh CT, TotalSegmentator labels
modality: automatic CT segmentation (TotalSegmentator total task, Apache-2.0)
body_region: whole body (trunk, upper limb, head; femora and hip bones overlap Denver)
format: NIfTI label map -> binary viewer chunks
resolution: 1.5 mm model on 0.94 x 0.94 x 1 mm CT
download_size: 478 MB CT input; 12 MB gzip viewer geometry
access_restrictions: public; attribution "Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine"; derived labels must state they do not come from NLM
notes: Derived here (scripts/build-nlm-vhf-volume.py, TotalSegmentator, scripts/register-nlm-ct.py, scripts/ingest-nlm-vhf.py). Same donor as Denver; placed in VHF-image-2022 by a rigid pelvis registration (rotation 2 deg, scale check 1.00, p95 about 4 mm). Masks are model output, not reviewed. Licensed TotalSegmentator subtasks (appendicular_bones) were not used.

name: Bone Mesh Female Toolkit v1.0
access_restrictions: public; LICENSE covers "this software" with no data carve-out; Zenodo record 889060 says other-open; authors not yet asked (request drafted in docs/LICENSING.md)
notes: Compared bone by bone with Denver in the VHF frame 2026-09-05 (generated/bmftoolkit-comparison.json): segmented right bones p95 median 1.7 mm, mirrored left 2.6 mm, sacrum (symmetrized) 15.6 mm. Not shipped.

name: NLM Visible Human Female
download_size: 478 MB fresh CT (1734 slices + headers) downloaded; cryosections not downloaded
access_restrictions: public; no licence or registration since July 2019; attribution "Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine"; redistributed derivatives must say whether they reflect current NLM data
notes: Verified 2026-09-05: terms page and Female-Images README fetched (data/raw/nlm-vhf, SHA-256 manifest). Fresh CT assembled into one RAS volume (scripts/build-nlm-vhf-volume.py), segmented with TotalSegmentator (CPU) and registered rigidly to the Denver pelvis: rotation 2.1 deg, free scale 1.003, pelvis p95 4.5 mm (generated/nlm-ct-registration.json). Frozen CT and cryosections not used yet.
